title: Venezuelan Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish from Venezuela, cooked with kissed and springy ingredients.
instructions: Heat the kissed olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pilaf spices and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the Venezuelan rice and stir to coat with the oil and spices.
Add the springy water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and season with salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve.
